subject: Renewal pricing: bridge credits & commit flexibility (Voyaprime)
messages:
From: Kai Morales <kai@voyaprime.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@voyaprime.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: renewal pricing & capacity for Q3 launch

David —

Quick note from our side: we’re ramping our new recommendation engine in mid-July and expect token consumption to roughly triple over the next 6 months. Current committed capacity will not cover the launch spike. Procurement asked me to see if Redwood can: 1) hold current unit pricing for six months or until our next budget cycle, and 2) provide a short bridge of credits to offset overage during launch week(s).

Numbers: current committed monthly token equivalent = 120M; projected peak month = ~360M. We’re open to increasing commit if that helps keep a hold on pricing.

Can you share a short proposal (numbers + basic amendment language)? Procurement would like something they can feed to legal and finance for a PO. Attaching last quarter usage for reference.

Thanks,
Kai Morales
Head of Product, Voyaprime
[Attachment: Voyaprime_Q1-usage-report.csv]
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Morales <kai@voyaprime.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: renewal pricing & capacity for Q3 launch

Kai —

Appreciate the heads-up and congrats on the launch prep. High-level proposal below; I put Marissa and Karthik on copy to confirm numbers and any legal/ops constraints.

Option A (short-term bridge, minimal commit):
- 90-day price hold on current per-token rates (applies to both generation + embeddings routes)
- One-time bridge credit equal to 20% of expected incremental usage for launch month (est. incremental = 240M tokens -> credit = 48M tokens)
- No change to existing committed monthly minimums; true-up at quarter end to reconcile real usage

Option B (commit uplift with longer price protection):
- Increase committed monthly baseline to 300M tokens for a 6-month term
- Price hold for the 6-month term at current unit rates
- Negative true-up protection: we offer phased credit if actual usage is < 90% of new commit in any month (to reduce downside)
- Initial bridging credit (as above) applied against month 1 overage

Next steps I suggest: I’ll prepare an amendment draft (short one-page) and a simple spreadsheet with the delta math. If procurement confirms they can issue a PO for the increased commit, we can route for an expedited signature (DocuSign).

Questions for you: preferred term for price hold (90 days vs 180 days), and whether finance needs the credit expressed as $ or token-equivalent.

Attaching a quick amendment draft; Marissa/Karthik — do we have headroom on the credit and the discount mechanics?

Thanks,
David Kim
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-amendment-draft.docx]
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Voyaprime proposal — need signoff on credit + commit uplift

Folks —

Looping you in early. Voyaprime is asking for either a short bridge + 90-day price hold (Option A) or a larger commit for 6 months + price protection (Option B). I recommended both to keep options open.

Numbers (rough):
- Current commit: 120M tokens/month
- Projected peak: 360M tokens (single month)
- Option A bridge credit: 48M tokens (20% of incremental)
- Option B new commit: 300M tokens/month for 6 months

Operational asks:
- Marissa — can we absorb a 48M token credit in Q2 without requiring revenue adjustments? If we express the bridge as a token-credit, finance can mark it against usage; if they need $, I can provide a conversion at current per-token rate.
- Karthik — any ops/legal constraints on temporary price holds and staged commits (especially on the negative true-up protection)? We need a short amendment that legal is comfortable with.

If we get greenlights, I’ll send the amendment to Kai and ask for a PO. I’d like to keep turnaround to 3 business days since product launch timelines are tight.

Thanks —
David
From: Kai Morales <kai@voyaprime.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@voyaprime.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: renewal pricing & capacity for Q3 launch

David —

Option B looks closest to what our CFO wants (6-month commit uplift + price protection). A couple of clarifying items from procurement:

- We will submit a PO that covers the first month of the increased commit. Can you confirm invoice timing (immediate vs net-30 after signed amendment)?
- We’d prefer the bridge credit expressed as token-equivalent to avoid FX/discount accounting complexity.
- Can legal confirm this amendment won’t change existing data-handling terms (we need that to stay same for our compliance review).

If you can send the cleaned amendment + DocuSign link and an invoice note, we’ll route to PO and signatures today.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Kai
[Attachment: Voyaprime_PO-0427.pdf]
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Morales <kai@voyaprime.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@voyaprime.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: renewal pricing & capacity for Q3 launch — amendment and next steps

Kai —

Thanks — we’re set to proceed with Option B. Attached is the amended one-page exhibit that: 1) sets the temporary monthly commit to 300M tokens for the 6-month window, 2) locks current per-token pricing for that period, and 3) applies a one-time bridge credit of 48M tokens (token-equivalent) to be applied during the first month of increased consumption. Legal confirms there’s no change to our existing data-handling or security terms; this is an operational pricing amendment only.

Invoice note: we’ll invoice the increased commit at the time of the first month’s billing cycle after signature (standard net-30 unless you request otherwise). If you want immediate invoicing to match the PO, confirm and we’ll mark it as due on receipt.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/embedded/12345-vo-prime

Attachments: redwood-amendment-draft.docx (finalized), Voyaprime_PO-0427.pdf (procurement copy)

If procurement confirms PO + signature timer today, I’ll coordinate ops to ensure capacity is available for the July launch window.

Best,
David Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
